verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed HMRC's developer hub serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit rules, a wildcard "Disallow: /" plus a Googlebot-only Allow, so an agent can learn its permissions before fetching anything else. The policy is restrictive, but the story asks only that the rules be published and readable, which they are. Missing for 10: robots.txt evidence for the main gov.uk and API hosts, any documented first-party crawler or agent access policy, and independent corroboration beyond a single probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-07; "Disallow: /" for * present, Googlebot-only Allow present)
